hero: We file early, so a question is still a question, not a problem.
sub: If a figure looks odd, we would rather find it in November than on the last evening of January. Filing early buys the time to ask you, and to answer it properly.

hero: We handle the handover and write to your old accountant. You sign once.
sub: That letter has a name in our trade, professional clearance, and it is ordinary courtesy between firms. We write it, follow it up, and tell you when your records arrive.

hero: Everything we file for you is scanned and kept, year by year.
sub: It stays your paperwork. HMRC accepts scanned copies, so we scan as we go, and a figure or document from an earlier year comes from us, not from a box in the loft.

setup: The cheque is in the post. It has been since August.
punch: It must be taking the scenic route.
hook: Write down every chase and the date you made it, and keep that note with the invoice.

line: No great thing is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig.
